description: Validate an email address before sending: syntax, MX, disposable and role account. $0.005 USDC on Base per call. Returns a verdict of ok, risky or undeliverable with syntax, MX, disposable (CC0 list), role account and free provider flags. Bad syntax returns 400, not charged. Don't use this for confirming a mailbox exists; no SMTP probe is made. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: inboxguards_email_check
title: InboxGuards Email Test: GET /v1/email-check
